paragraphs: Page Our Company Investment Management Human Capital Management Regulation Information about our Executive Officers

We are one of the largest providers of retirement solutions and insurance products in the United States, committed to helping individuals plan, save for and achieve secure financial futures. Our addressable markets are large, with powerful, long-term secular trends given an aging U.S. population and a growing need for retirement solutions. We offer a broad set of products and services through our market leading Individual Retirement, Group Retirement, Life Insurance and Institutional Markets businesses, each of which features capabilities and industry experience we believe are difficult to replicate. These four businesses collectively seek to enhance stockholder returns while maintaining our attractive risk profile, which has historically resulted in consistent and strong cash flow generation.
Our strong competitive position is supported by:

•our scaled platform and position as a leading life and annuity company across a broad range of products and service offerings, managing or administering $386.4 billion in client assets as of December 31, 2025;
•our four businesses, which provide a diversified and attractive mix of spread income, fee income and underwriting margin;

•our broad distribution platform, which gives us access to end customers, consultants, retirement plan sponsors, banks, broker-dealers, general agencies, independent marketing organizations and independent insurance agents;
•our proven expertise in product design, which positions us to optimize risk-adjusted returns as we grow our business;
•our strategic partnerships with Blackstone and BlackRock which we believe allows us to access more diverse asset classes and benefit from scale and market-leading capabilities;

•our high-quality liability profile, supported by our strong balance sheet and disciplined approach to risk management, which has limited our exposure to product features and portfolios with less attractive risk-adjusted returns;
•our ability to deliver attractive cash flows and financial returns; and
•our strong and experienced senior management team.

We believe we have an attractive business mix that balances spread-based income, fee income and underwriting margin sources and is diversified across our broad product suite. For the year ended December 31, 2025, our businesses generated spread income of $3.9 billion, fee income of $1.2 billion and underwriting margin of $1.4 billion, resulting in a balanced mix of 60%, 18% and 22%, respectively, among these income sources. We are well-diversified across our operating businesses with our Individual Retirement, Group Retirement, Life Insurance and Institutional Markets businesses representing 52%, 20%, 12% and 16% of associated Adjusted Pre-Tax Operating Income ("APTOI"), respectively, for the year ended December 31, 2025.

Our diversified business model is enabled by our long-standing distribution relationships that are distinguished through both their breadth and depth. We have large distribution platforms in the U.S. life and retirement market, with a wide range of relationships with financial advisors, insurance agents and plan sponsors, as well as our own employee financial advisors and direct-to-consumer platform. Corebridge Financial Distributors, our Retail sales platform, serves as a valuable partner to our third-party distributors, including banks, broker-dealers, general agencies, independent marketing organizations and independent insurance agents.

A disciplined approach to investment management is at the core of our business. We rely on third-party asset managers as well as our own internal capabilities to generate a wide array of asset classes to best position our investment portfolio. We believe our strategic partnership with Blackstone allows us to leverage Blackstone's ability to originate attractive and privately sourced fixed-income oriented assets that are well suited for liability-driven investing within an insurance company framework. Additionally, BlackRock's scale and fee structure make BlackRock an excellent outsourcing partner for certain asset classes and allows us to further optimize our investment management operating model while improving overall performance.

These risks are discussed more fully in "Risk Factors." These risks include the following:
•changes in interest rates and changes to credit spreads;

•the deterioration of economic conditions, an economic slowdown or recession, changes in market conditions, weakening in capital markets, volatility in equity markets, inflationary pressures, pressures on the commercial real estate market, and geopolitical tensions;
•the unpredictability of the amount and timing of insurance liability claims;
•unavailable, uneconomical or inadequate reinsurance or recaptures of reinsured liabilities;
•uncertainty and unpredictability related to our reinsurance agreements and the reinsurers' performance of their obligations under these agreements;

paragraphs: 頁數 本公司 投資管理 人力資源管理 規則 與執行長之資訊

本公司為美國最大的退休解決方案與保險產品供應商之一，致力於協助個人規劃、儲蓄並實現穩定的財務未來。我們的可接觸市場規模龐大，因美國人口老化與退休解決方案需求增加，呈現強勁且長遠的產業趨勢。我們透過市場領先的個人退休、團體退休、人壽保險與機構市場業務，提供廣泛的產品與服務，每項業務均具備我們認為難以複製的專業能力與產業經驗。這四項業務 collectively 旨在提升股東回報，同時維持我們具吸引力的風險特質，這一特質歷來已產生穩定且強勁的現金流。
我們強大的競爭優勢由以下因素支撐：
• 我們規模化的平台與作為領先的人壽與年金公司之地位，於廣泛的產品與服務提供上，截至2025年12月31日，管理或代管客戶資產達3864億美元；
• 我們的四項業務，提供多元化且具吸引力的利差收入、費用收入與承保邊際收入組合；
• 我們廣泛的銷售平台，使我們能接觸終端客戶、顧問、退休計畫贊助人、銀行、經紀商、總代理、獨立行銷組織與獨立保險經紀人；
• 我們在產品設計方面的成熟專業，使我們在業務成長時能優化風險調整後回報；
• 我們與Blackstone與BlackRock的戰略合作夥伴關係，我們認為這使我們能接觸更多元的資產類別，並受益於規模與市場領先的專業能力；
•本公司高品質的負債結構，由強固的資產負債表及嚴謹的風險管理方式所支撐，此方式已限制我們對較低吸引力風險調整後報酬產品功能與產品組合的曝露；
•本公司能提供具吸引力的現金流與財務報酬能力；以及
•本公司強而有經驗的高階管理團隊。

我們認為本公司擁有具吸引力的業務組合，能平衡基準利差收入、手續費收入與承保邊際收入來源，並在廣泛的產品組閤中實現多元化。於2025年12月31日財務年度，本公司業務產生基準利差收入39億美元、手續費收入12億美元與承保邊際收入14億美元，分別佔這些收入來源的60%、18%與22%。本公司在營運業務上具有良好的多元化，於2025年12月31日財務年度，個人退休、團體退休、人壽保險與機構市場業務分別佔相關調整前稅前營運收入（"APTOI"）的52%、20%、12%與16%。
本公司多元化的業務模式受益於長期的分銷關係，這些關係以其廣度與深度而著稱。我們在美國人壽與退休市場擁有龐大的分銷平台，與財務顧問、保險經紀人與計畫贊助人擁有廣泛的關係，同時也擁有本公司員工財務顧問與直接對消費者平台。Corebridge Financial Distributors為我們的零售銷售平台，作為我們第三方分銷商的寶貴夥伴，包括銀行、經紀商、總代理、獨立行銷組織與獨立保險經紀人。

對投資管理的嚴謹態度是本公司業務的核心。我們依賴第三方資產管理機構以及本公司內部能力，以產生多樣化的資產類別，以最佳化投資組合的定位。我們認為與Blackstone的戰略合作夥伴關係使我們能善用Blackstone產生具吸引力且來自私人來源的固定收益類資產的能力，這些資產非常適合在保險公司架構下進行負債驅動型投資。此外，BlackRock的規模與費用結構使其成為某些資產類別的優秀委外夥伴，並使我們能進一步優化投資管理營運模式，同時提升整體表現。

paragraphs: 本公司業務面臨許多風險，包括可能使本公司無法達成業務目標或財務目標，或以其他方式對本公司業務、營運成果、財務狀況及流動性造成不利影響的風險，您應謹慎考慮。這些風險在『風險因素』中更詳細地討論。這些風險包括以下內容：
•利率變動及信用 spreads 變動；
•經濟條件惡化、經濟成長減緩或衰退、市場條件變動、資本市場走弱、股市波動、通貨膨脹壓力、商業不動產市場壓力及國際政治緊張關係；
•保險賠償責任金額及時點的不確定性；
•無法取得、成本過高或不足的再保險或再保責任回收；
•與本公司再保險契約及再保險公司履行契約義務的不確定性及預測困難；
